description: Defines classes and methods for asynchronous disk cache I/O operations in the net::disk_cache namespace, including BackendIO and InFlightBackendIO, with functions for opening, creating, doom, reading, writing, and managing cache entries.

classes.name: BackendIO
classes.description: Represents a single asynchronous disk cache I/O operation, supporting various cache entry operations and callbacks.

classes.name: InFlightBackendIO
classes.description: Manages multiple concurrent backend I/O operations, providing methods to initiate, cancel, and wait for operations.

methods.name: BackendIO::ExecuteOperation
methods.description: Runs the actual I/O operation on the background thread.

methods.name: BackendIO::OnIOComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked upon I/O completion with the result.

methods.name: BackendIO::OnDone
methods.description: Finalizes the operation, optionally cancelling callback invocation.

methods.name: InFlightBackendIO::OpenOrCreateEntry
methods.description: Opens or creates a cache entry.
